integrity.proof: A self-contained analytic derivation is provided; finite numerical checks support but do not replace the proof.
integrity.sources: General seismicity-state and cumulative-rate identities are credited to their original publications.
integrity.verification: A standard-library verification script is embedded. No external certification or empirical calibration was performed.

scientific_limitations: Applies to homogeneous positive stress offsets in the constant-normal-stress Dieterich constitutive model, not to full interacting fault systems.
Stress histories are mathematical controls, not assumed realizable as groundwater-injection or extraction rates.
Fixed integrated stress exposure is imposed for comparison and is not a physically conserved mechanical-energy budget.
The finite-horizon observable is expected nucleation count, not event magnitudes, probability of damaging shaking, or peak occurrence rate.
Full text of Dieterich 1994 was unavailable; an independently verified comprehensive novelty review has not been performed.
title: Sharp stress-exposure allocation bounds for finite-horizon seismicity
